comments: Information of tracklisting from Hal C F Astell's website.
Dumpy's Rusty Nuts, Twelfth Night, Waysted and Nazareth recorded live at the Kerrang! Wooargh! Weekender in Great Yarmouth held between 12-14 Oct 1984.

track_listing.track: Dumpy's Rusty Nuts - Live at the Kerrang! Wooargh! Weekender (on File 1)
Twelfth Night - Live at the Kerrang! Wooargh! Weekender (Tracks 1 - 3 on File 1. Track 4 on File 3)
Waysted - Live at the Kerrang! Wooargh! Weekender (File 2 and 3)
Nazareth - Live at the Kerrang! Wooargh! Weekender (* on File 3)

transcript.text: Oh, thank you. Thank you very much. Now this invites us all to turn around and have a quick look at who's behind you and who's in front of you and who you are yourself. And this is called Take a Look.
Andy Sears, Rick Battersby and Clive Mitten.
They were Twelfth Night.
And now here is a message for drivers heading for London's West End
and the Christmas decorations in Oxford Street and Regent Street.
A fire in the underground station at Oxford Circus
means that this very busy road junction has been closed to all traffic
and diversions are in operation.
Serious traffic congestion can be expected
and drivers are advised to keep clear of the area
and to seek alternative routes.
that is a fire in the underground station at Oxford Circus.
It means that the whole area, the entire area, is jammed.
I think he got the message.
Just take this Dennis fire engine out of my mouth
and we'll get back to the music that we recorded at the Kerrang! World Weekender
between the 12th and the 14th of October.
Wasted.
Well, you lose your money and you take your choice
and that's the price you pay.
Andy Parker, Paul Chapman, Pete Way and Finn.

The Price You Pay, Love Loaded, Rock Steady
and Get Out of Line.
